messages:
Alex: Standup - what I did / blockers / today
Alex: Did: rolled KV eviction fix to canary (eu-west batchers), patched batcher config to prefer small batch size for short seqs.
Alex: Blocker: still seeing 95th perc latency spikes ~1.2s on embeddings route when seq>1024. Suspect kernel selection fallback.
Alex: Today: will collect traces, open a short canary with `--batcher-max=16`, and coordinate with @Priya for tracing.

Priya: Got it. Can you paste the trace id? I ran a quick histogram and saw a tail at ~1.1s at 03:40 UTC.
Priya: Query I used: `sum(rate(embed_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)`
Priya: I can look into kernel selection if you share model id, also can toggle `KV_EVICT_WINDOW` to 120s as temporary.

Mike: FYI oncall: pagers from eu-west dropped after the eviction fix but two infra alerts fired this morning: AUTO-SCALE-403 & BATCHER-504.
Mike: I'm going to tune the autoscaler cooldown from 60->120s, will post results.

Eva: Ping @Alex on PR review - https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 - small change to warmup script. If nobody picks it up I'll merge after green.
Eva: Also volunteering to own warmup rollout for Dedicated tomorrow.

Josh: deploy-bot: `deploy infra/eu-west:b127 -> success` :white_check_mark:
Josh: Also note runbook link: https://redwood-infra.runbooks/slo-embed-latency

ops-bot: ALERT CLOSED - eu-west embed latency - incident #2341 - closed by Mike at 2024-04-01T09:12:23Z

Alex: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Priya to confirm kernel change (2) Mike will monitor autoscaler cooldown (3) Eva will handle warmup rollout. I'll post traces here when ready. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll try toggle and report by EOD.
Mike: I'll watch pager noise and roll back if needed.
Eva: dropping an update in morning shift.
Josh: small heads up - cr for batcher config will need a DB migration, please note in PR.
